name: @sos-2/recovery-control
description: SOS 2.0 Recovery Control: the rollback contract — every live change declares a bounded recovery mechanism, trigger, authority and evidence (RecoveryDeclaration artifacts, extension kind registered through the spine); unbounded/unspecified recovery is REJECTED unless an explicit governed exception record exists; the trusted recovery policy (require_bounded_recovery) is mutable ONLY through the authority-gated path (origin TRUSTED_OPERATORS + a valid @sos-2/authority grant carrying REVISE, plus a governed exception to weaken), and candidate-originated attempts to disable assurance controls are ALWAYS rejected (spec/architecture-lock.md) (Work Order W8; spec/architecture.md section 13, docs/assurance-model.md, R14).
